intent: The Factory's designer: for a web or mobile UI surface, composes the design craft skills into a scored, AI-slop-checked UI spec; reads the stack but never writes it; designs each surface to its platform (web via Tailwind/shadcn, mobile via Flutter/Material); records the spec as a run artifact the build reads.

dimensions.name: ui-spec-artifact
dimensions.criterion: Produces a UI spec recorded as a run artifact (02a-plan-design.md).

dimensions.name: wrap-not-rederive
dimensions.criterion: Composes the design craft skills rather than re-deriving them.

dimensions.name: score-and-slop-check
dimensions.criterion: Scores 0–10 per dimension and runs the AI-slop check as a gate.

dimensions.name: web-and-mobile-surfaces
dimensions.criterion: Handles web and mobile surfaces distinctly; mobile routes to Flutter/Material.

dimensions.name: reads-not-writes-stack
dimensions.criterion: Reads the stack; never writes tech_stack/commands (that is /plan-arch's).

dimensions.name: tokens-and-primitives-defined
dimensions.criterion: Defines the full token/primitive system (spacing scale, radius, elevation, complete type scale, component-state matrix) as code — never deferred.

dimensions.name: complete-navigation-map
dimensions.criterion: Maps every screen and every screen→action→screen transition, plus a Mermaid screen-flow emitted as one diagram per navigation cluster (stacked, readable) — not just the primary flows and an IA tree.

dimensions.name: records-run-artifact
dimensions.criterion: Records the UI spec via the run harness so the build resumes from it.
